Text note a/ (below source line): The Bank of Chosun is the National Depository of the South Korean Interim Government. The government deposits its revenues with the bank and draws on it for all government expenses. The Overdraft Account and the Revenue Deposit Account are kept separately by the bank and the government pays interest of 3 per cent on excess overdrafts over the revenue deposits.
